title: mRNA Extraction and cDNA Preparation
author: Shiyi Wang
materials: **Thaw and Resuspend Cells** - Thaw cells stored in TRIzol (15596026, Invitrogen). - Resuspend cells in 1 mL of TRIzol.
**Precipitate RNA** - Add GlycoBlue Coprecipitant (AM9515, Invitrogen) and isopropanol to precipitate the RNA.
**Quantify RNA** - Quantify the RNA using the Qubit RNA HS Assay Kit (Q32852, Invitrogen).

steps.title: Add Chloroform
steps.instruction: Add 200 μL of chloroform to the samples.

steps.title: Centrifuge Samples
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples at 12,000 g for 15 minutes at 4°C.

steps.title: Wash RNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA pellet with 75% ethanol.

steps.title: Dry and Resuspend RNA
steps.instruction: Air-dry the RNA pellet and resuspend it in 40 μL of nuclease-free water.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the RNA in 40 μL of nuclease-free water

steps.title: Isolate RNA
steps.instruction: Isolate the RNA using the Zymo Research RNA Clean & Concentrator-5 Kit (R1014, Zymo).

steps.title: Equalize RNA Concentrations
steps.instruction: Dilute the RNA to equalize concentrations.

steps.title: Generate cDNA Libraries
steps.instruction: Prepare cDNA libraries using qScript cDNA SuperMix (101414-102, VWR) following a specific temperature profile.

steps.title: Dilute and Store cDNA
steps.instruction: Dilute the resulting cDNA threefold and store at −80°C.
